description: Leprosy, or Hansen disease, is a chronic infection caused by Mycobacterium leprae that primarily affects skin and peripheral nerves.
symptoms: Nerve thickening or weakness may occur
risk_factors: Prolonged close contact with an untreated case

appearance.general: One or more lighter, reddish, or coppery skin patches may occur with reduced sensation; nodules or diffuse infiltration can occur in some forms.

warning_signs: New numbness, weakness, eye symptoms, or nerve pain requires medical assessment.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss sensory changes, nerve symptoms, household exposure, and duration of lesions.
